steps.title: Step 1: Open X Developer Portal
steps.desc: Go to developer.x.com and sign in. Click on 'Products' and choose 'Twitter API v2' (The Free or Basic version is perfect).

steps.title: Step 2: Create Your App
steps.desc: Click 'Create Project' and name it anything you like (e.g. 'Pintopay Studio'). Then, inside that project, create an 'App'.

steps.title: Step 3: Set Writing Power
steps.desc: Go to App Settings > Set up User Authentication. Choose 'OAuth 1.0a'. Switch permissions from 'Read Only' to 'Read and Write'. For the Website/Callback URL fields, just paste: https://t.me/pintopay_probot

steps.title: Step 4: Get Your 4 Magic Keys
steps.desc: Go to the 'Keys and Tokens' tab. Click 'Regenerate' for Consumer Keys and 'Generate' for Access Tokens. Copy all 4 codes: API Key, API Secret, Access Token, and Access Secret.

steps.title: Step 5: Connect to P2PHub
steps.desc: Paste those 4 codes into the API Setup box here and click 'SAVE SETTINGS'. You're now ready to post to X!

steps.title: Step 6: Unlock Infinite Context (Pro Tip)
steps.desc: X limits 'Free' accounts to very short posts. To publish the massive, high-conversion AI deep-dives (300+ characters), we highly recommend upgrading to X Premium. This also unlocks the 'Basic' API tier, which ensures your viral engine runs at 100% velocity.

steps.title: Step 1: Create a Channel
steps.desc: Click 'New Channel' in your Telegram app. Give it a cool name and a profile picture.

steps.title: Step 2: Add Your Bot Helper
steps.desc: Go to your channel settings > Administrators > Add Admin. Search for @{{bot_username}} and add it.

steps.title: Step 3: Give Permission
steps.desc: When adding the bot, make sure 'Post Messages' is turned ON (green). This lets the bot send your viral posts for you.

steps.title: Step 4: Link to P2PHub
steps.desc: Copy your channel's public link (like @mycoolchannel) and paste it into the API Setup box here. Click Save and you're done!

hook_rule.content: You have 1.2 seconds to capture attention. A great hook addresses a specific pain point or a massive desire immediately. Without a hook, your content is invisible.

algorithm.content: Algorithms favor engagement early on. Use controversial statements or open loops to keep users commenting and sharing. The goal is to maximize the initial 15 minutes of reach.

psycho.title: High-Ticket Psychology
psycho.content: People buy on emotion and justify with logic. Use FOMO (Fear of Missing Out) and Social Proof to bypass skepticism and build instant authority.
